settings.invalidValue: Enter a valid value within the allowed range. Colors accept #RGB, #RRGGBB, #RRGGBBAA, rgb() or rgba(). Lists must be valid JSON arrays.

settings.dwellNote: Pressure reveal is replaced by edge dwell time (Reveal delay).
settings.hotkeyNote: Super / SuperAlt bindings are configured in docs/hotkeys.md. The plugin never edits Hyprland bindings.
settings.resetConfirm: Reset all settings to the defaults, the Windows look? A backup is saved first. Your pinned applications and unknown settings are kept.

settings.importHelp: Import merges recognized keys present in the selected file. Existing unknown keys are kept. Favorites change only if the import explicitly includes favorites. A file that adds commands shows them before anything is imported. Export contains the current file, including unknown keys.
